Sweet Flavor

Treacle

About This Entry

Treacle is a canonical British dark cane syrup for puddings and gingerbread ingredient in global cookery — its sweetness character, texture, and pairing behavior pair with dessert wines, sparkling styles, and spice-friendly reds when used as a primary sweetener.
